cs.t: I have a USB-C JBL speaker (Flip 5) which charges alright with a USB-C to USB-C cable (and USB-C charger), but only in one direction. So sometimes I have to plug it, realize nothing is happening, unplug, flip the cable and plug it again for it to start charging.
cs.th: USB-C hubs and my slow descent into madness (2021)

cs.t: I have a power speaker that goes on a big tripod, but I only use it for Karaoke or when I need to crank loud music outside. The JBL Flip 4 I have used for just casual music in the garden.
cs.th: Ask HN: What did you purchase that measurably improved your quality of life?
